# Insomnia Masterclass ads — the copy deck

**Generated from `src/copy.js`. Do not edit this file by hand — edit the copy deck and run `node src/build-copy-md.js`.**

Three audiences × 7 concepts × 3 sizes = **63 rendered ads**.

**12 distinct copy sets.** The other 9 are the photo cuts, 
which run their parent concept's exact words so the A/B measures the photograph and nothing else.

## The offer

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Event | Free Insomnia Masterclass, live on Zoom |
| Date | Wednesday, Aug 26 (verified: 2026-08-26 is a Wednesday) |
| Time | `4:00 PM` **fill before launch** |
| Host | Dr. Nishi Bhopal, MD, board certified in psychiatry and sleep medicine |
| Registration URL | `[ADD REGISTRATION URL]` **fill before launch** — the masterclass opt-in page, NOT intrabalance.com/register |

## Audiences

| Lane | Who | Credit line | Prescribes? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `physicians` | MD / DO | CME | yes |
| `nps` | Nurse practitioners / APRNs | CME/CE | yes |
| `allied` | Psychologists, PAs and coaches | CME/CE | mixed — no line in this lane depends on writing a script |

Meta targeting per lane:

- **Physicians** — MD/DO. AAFP, ACP, integrative and functional medicine (IFM, A4M), CME interests, plus a lookalike from past registrants.
- **Nurse Practitioners** — NP/APRN. AANP, PMHNP and FNP groups, primary care and psych NP interests, nursing CE interests, plus a lookalike from past registrants.
- **Psychologists, PAs & Coaches** — Psychologists (APA, PsyD/PhD), PAs (AAPA), and health/sleep coaches (NBHWC). Behavioural sleep medicine, CBT and health coaching interests, plus a lookalike from past registrants.
